data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 训练室的节奏
data.description: 训练室里，沙袋还在轻轻晃动。她站稳脚步，抬手准备下一次练习。
data.action: standing in a boxing stance in front of a hanging punching bag
data.promptProse: In a spartan, underground boxing gym lit by stark fluorescent tubes, Bazett stands in a sharp southpaw combat stance before a heavy leather punching bag, wrapped knuckles raised. Sweat glistens on her toned shoulders and jawline, with chalk dust, skipping ropes, and concrete pillars framing her formidable martial discipline.
